trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE o.name = 'William Chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE toLower(o.name) = 'william chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'Chisholm' MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(td:Document) MATCH (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(od:Document) RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE toLower(trim(o.name)) = 'william chisholm' OR (toLower(o.name) CONTAINS 'william' AND toLower(o.name) CONTAINS 'chisholm') RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
